name: Triumph Trident 660
engine: 660 cc liquid-cooled inline triple, fuel injected
intro: Triumph's middleweight triple. Every 2022-2024 bike is in a MAP sensor hose recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2022-2024 bikes are in recall 23V583 (MAP sensor hose can block and stall the engine). Some 2022 bikes are in recall 22V062 (side stand) and some 2023 bikes in recall 24V109 (fork caps can strip).
A-002.reason: A stall or a fork cap coming off is a crash risk. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: MAP sensor hose may be blocked, giving bad readings that cause rough idle or a stall.
Front fork caps with bad threads may strip and come off the fork tube.
